## 💡 Feature Summary

A clear and concise summary of the feature you're requesting.

## Problem Statement

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

Describe the problem you're facing. e.g. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Coastal / Disaster Relief Context

How does this feature help coastal communities, fishermen, or disaster relief operations in India?

## Alternatives Considered

A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why your proposed solution is better.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have technical ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here:

- Frontend changes needed?
- New API endpoints?
- Third-party integrations?
- ML/AI components?

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] 🔴 Critical — Platform is unusable without this
- [ ] 🟠 High — Significantly improves safety outcomes
- [ ] 🟡 Medium — Nice to have, improves UX
- [ ] 🟢 Low — Minor improvement or cosmetic change

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or links here.
